data.title: Know who’s here in the first five minutes.
data.lead: Guests scan in on their own phones, with no app to download. You see who’s in, who’s late and who’s new, let in the walk-ins you choose, and hand the door to a helper whose access ends with the night.
data.note: Capability page 3 (priority 2). From docs/host_product.md: QR self check-in with no download, roster search and manual check-in, event-scoped expiring staff access, host-approved walk-ins, Luma roster sync. Decision: offline is described as “check-ins sync later”, not “works offline”.

data.title: However they arrive, they’re on the list.

items.d: A code at the door opens your event in their phone’s browser. They confirm with their number and they’re in.
Search the list by name and check them in yourself, plus-ones included.
Add a walk-in in a few seconds, if you have room. They’re on the list for the follow-up too.
Import a guest list from any tool, or connect Luma and Catch keeps the list in step.

data.title: Hand over the door, not your business.
data.lead: Give a friend or a venue’s staff the door for one event. They can search the list and check people in, and that’s all. Their access ends when you say, or with the event.
ticks: No Catch profile needed to run the door
No access to your other events, your contacts or your money
Take access back at any time

data.title: Basement bar? Check-ins still count.
data.lead: If the signal drops while you’re checking people in, the check-ins are saved on your phone and sync when you’re back online. If two people checked in the same guest, Catch shows you so you can sort it out.
data.body: Open the door list before you lose signal, so it’s on your phone.

rows.s: They’ll send when you’re back online.

data.title: The list keeps working.
data.lead: Who came and who didn’t goes into your guest records. Who showed up is who gets the photos, the review request and the invitation to the next one.

media.alt: The door list once everyone is in

data.title: About the door.
items: Do guests need to download anything?
No. The code at the door opens your event in their phone’s browser. They confirm with their phone number.
What if someone’s phone is dead?
Search their name and check them in yourself. Plus-ones can be checked in with them.
Yes, if you choose to. Add them at the door and they’re on the list like everyone else.
Can more than one person run the door?
Yes. Give each helper door access for the event, on their own phone. If two of you check in the same guest, Catch shows you so you can sort it out.
Check-ins made without signal are saved on the phone and sync when it reconnects. Open the door list before you lose signal.
I sell tickets on Luma. Can I still use the door?
Yes. Connect your Luma account and Catch keeps the guest list and check-ins in step, or import a guest list from any other tool.
